product_metadata.title: Lighted Tabletop Christmas Tree, Multicolored Fiber Optic Lights Flashing, Battery Operated 20" Mini Prelit Green Christmas Tree with Red Ball Ornaments, for Xmas Home Holiday Festive Decorations
features: Colored Fiber Optic LED Lighted Mini Tree: Plenty of fiber optic filaments were built in green PVC branches. Once turn on this tree, colorful lights begin flashing and changing on their own. The multi-colored LED lights are operated with 3 AA batteries (not include). Easy to make the Christmas festive spirit full of room.

Full Green 20" Mini Christmas Tree: 20 inch tall with 35 branches. 9 pcs shiny red ball ornaments were already glued on. The evergreen branch tips make the prelit mini Christmas tree full and life-like.

Easy to Use and Store: The lighted tabletop Christmas tree is well packed in a beautiful printed box. There are only one section, no need to assemble. You just need adjust and shape the branches and put 3 AA batteries in the base. Then turn on the button, the mini Christmas tree can be lighten colorfully. No need any plug or USB.

Wide Applications: Perfect size as a Christmas decoration for table, desk, fireplace mantle, windowsil, and showcase. Ideal for Christmas, festival party, office, indoor, apartment, home, room decoration, etc.

Perfect Choice as Christmas Gift: Christmas is coming. You want to send gifts for your beloved ones. This colored lighted tabletop Christmas tree is a perfect choice. Your children, families, friends, and neighbors will love it so much.
